text: How much Russian refining capacity is actually down? Ukraine's General Staff said 42.74% in July. The IEA said losses were "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Three attributed figures from the tracker's unresolved-dispute record, no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%

text: Ukraine reportedly hit the Kerch (Crimean) bridge and launched its largest drone attack on Russia of the war, including Moscow. Reported Nov 16; damage and casualty details are not yet confirmed.

judge.comment: Wording preserves 'reportedly' and states details are unconfirmed; matches tracker digest and event.

factChecks.claim: Largest drone attack on Russia since the war began, including Moscow

text: How much Russian refining capacity is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (Jul 2026). IEA: "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3-6%.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed without adjudication; IEA and Reuters figures lack exact as-of dates in the tracker data, so human review is advised.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were more than 20% at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%

text: Russian airstrikes on a Ukrainian aid hub reportedly killed 72 people, and the rescue site was struck nine more times, per UNITED24 Media. Single-outlet figure as of Nov 17; independent confirmation not yet logged.

judge.comment: Significant event but the casualty figure rests on a single outlet (UNITED24 Media) and is marked 'reportedly'; a human should confirm sourcing before publishing.

factChecks.claim: 72 killed in airstrikes on aid hub
rescue site struck nine more times

text: The US is moving to curb remote access to Nvidia's advanced AI chips; the Trump administration has ordered Commerce to close the loophole (Nov 17). Context: China reportedly stalled Nvidia H200 imports on Nov 7 to favour domestic chips.

text: Lebanon's Health Ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 March, with no civilian/combatant split. Israel and independent estimates put Hezbollah fighter deaths at ~1,700–2,500; Hezbollah publishes no totals. Tracker figures, Nov 2026.

judge.comment: Both positions attributed and unadjudicated; the 4,386 as-of date is the tracker's KPI rather than a dated ministry release, so a human should check the date.

factChecks.claim: 4,386 killed in Lebanon (MoH), cumulative since 2 March, no civilian/combatant split
Hezbollah fighters killed ~1,700–2,500 per IDF/independent estimates
